Who We Are
Cardiff's Favourite
Chippy.

Top Deck Fish & Chips has been a Cardiff institution on Cowbridge Road East, serving up freshly battered cod, haddock, scampi and so much more to the good people of Canton and beyond.

Everything is cooked fresh to order. From our perfectly crisp chips to our range of pies, chicken, curries and classic fried favourites — we do things the proper way, every single time.

With over 4,000 reviews on Uber Eats and a 4.5-star Google rating, the proof is in the pudding — or rather, in the batter.
